summary: ITER145.A Multilingual Email Identity Studio + Tenant Locale Orchestration verified end-to-end. Backend: pytest test_iter145_multilingual_email.py 10/10 PASS; aggregate (ITER143a/c/d/e + ITER144 + ITER144_1 + ITER145) 61/61 PASS, zero regression. All required API surfaces validated via direct calls: GET /api/content/page/system-email-auth-reset returns 7 blocks per locale (Reimposta for it-IT, Reset for en-US, no Italian leak), /api/tenant/configuration exposes locales {enabled[5]=[it-IT,en-US,fr-FR,de-DE,es-ES] excluding en-GB, default=it-IT in enabled, fallback, locale_source=tenant, available_platform_locales[6]}, /api/blueprint-admin/runtime-inspector exposes locale.ale_status {email_blocks=35, email_translations=210, stale=0, locales_covered=6}, POST /api/tenant/email-branding/preview returns ALE-translated subjects for it-IT/en-US/fr-FR (all 3 distinct). Frontend /settings/email-branding: all required data-testids present (email-branding-page, preview-device-toggle + desktop/mobile, preview-color-toggle + dark/light, branding-preview-locale select, branding-identity-source badge='SOURCE · TENANT_LEGACY', branding-preview/Anteprima). Locale dropdown options exactly match tenant.enabled_locales (5 locales, en-GB NOT present — isolation correct). Clicking Anteprima with locale=en-US renders iframe whose body contains 'Reset' and NOT 'Reimposta' (verified via content_frame inspection). Mobile/Light visual toggles work (iframe ~375px width with rounded corners on light background — visible in screenshot). Source code review confirms branding-preview-container has data-device-mode={deviceMode} and data-color-mode={colorMode} React-bound attributes. Owner Introduction modal correctly dismissable via [aria-label='Close']. /admin/runtime-inspector page renders with locale-related runtime-stat-source/default/enabled testids.

integration_issues.issue: On a fresh page load after dismissing the Owner Introduction modal, the very first click on [data-testid='branding-preview'] occasionally does NOT trigger the preview render (previewHtml remains empty, container does not mount). Second click or re-click after changing locale always works. May be a transient focus/event race after modal close. Not a code defect but worth verifying that the modal close handler doesn't swallow the next click event.

issues: Heatmap pill in bottom-right still flags 'MISS 15 · LEAK 13' on /settings/email-branding and 'MISS 0 · LEAK 3' on /admin/runtime-inspector. Unrelated to ITER145 scope but visible during testing (pre-existing language heatmap noise from ITER144.1 testing).

action_items: (Low) Investigate first-click race on [data-testid='branding-preview'] right after Owner Introduction modal close — possibly add explicit focus blur or a setTimeout(0) in the modal-close handler so the next click event registers reliably.

(Informational) Heatmap leakage/miss counters on /settings/email-branding (MISS 15, LEAK 13) and /admin/runtime-inspector (MISS 0, LEAK 3) are inherited from earlier iterations — out of ITER145 scope.
critical_code_review_comments: email_editorial_resolver.filter_to_enabled() correctly degrades en-GB → en-US when tenant enabled_locales=[it-IT,en-US,...] (in-family family-match) and degrades ja-JP → default it-IT (no family match). Locale isolation is tight.

email_templates.render() retains hardcoded Italian as ultimate safety net for unmapped locales (documented zero-downtime architectural rule) — verified via test_resolve_email_copy_fallback_chain_in_family (en-AU still produces an email).
EmailBrandingPage.jsx line 303-305: branding-preview-container has React-bound data-device-mode and data-color-mode — clean test-friendly contract.

Locale dropdown is filtered via enabledLocales state (from /api/tenant/configuration.locales.enabled_locales) — confirms no global platform locale leak in tenant UI. en-GB correctly NOT shown for demo tenant.

Runtime Inspector locale.ale_status returns numeric counters (email_blocks=35, email_translations=210, stale=0) + locales_covered array (6 lowercase locale codes) — good governance observability surface.

success_rate.frontend: 100% functional — all testids present, all toggles work, locale isolation works, English iframe renders. One transient first-click race documented.
